customMethods.name: appendKey
customMethods.script:
# Digits only, capped at 5. The 5th digit submits immediately -- the
	# operator taps five keys and is signed in, no Enter to hunt for.
	self.view.custom.error = ""
	if ch is None or not str(ch).isdigit():
		return
	current = self.view.custom.pin or ""
	if len(current) >= 5:
		return
	current = current + str(ch)
	self.view.custom.pin = current
	if len(current) == 5:
		self.submitPin()

customMethods.name: loginAs
submitPin
customMethods.script:
if self.view.custom.dialogOpen:
		return
	text = (self.view.custom.pin or "").strip()
	if len(text) != 5:
		self.view.custom.error = ""
		return
	u = BlueRidge.Location.AppUser.getActiveByPin(text)
	if u is not None:
		self.view.custom.error = ""
		self.loginAs(u["Id"], u["Initials"], u["DisplayName"], u.get("IgnitionRole"))
		return
	# Not an active user. A deprecated (deactivated) person is blocked with a
	# clear message -- they cannot self-register, the PIN is already taken --
	# while a genuinely unknown PIN is offered self-registration.
	dep = BlueRidge.Location.AppUser.getByPin(text)
	if dep is not None:
		self.view.custom.error = "That operator is deactivated. See a supervisor."
		self.view.custom.pin = ""
		return
	self.view.custom.dialogOpen = True
	system.perspective.openPopup(id="mpp-unknown-initials", view="BlueRidge/Components/Popups/UnknownInitials", params={"pin": text, "replyMessage": "unknownInitialsResult", "popupId": "mpp-unknown-initials"}, modal=True, showCloseIcon=False)

messageHandlers.script:
action = payload.get("action") if payload else None
	if action == "register":
		system.perspective.openPopup(id="mpp-register-operator", view="BlueRidge/Components/Popups/RegisterOperator", params={"pin": (self.view.custom.pin or "").strip(), "replyMessage": "registerOperatorResult", "popupId": "mpp-register-operator"}, modal=True, showCloseIcon=False)
	else:
		# "retype" -- and any unexpected reply -- returns to a blank pad rather
		# than leaving a half-entered PIN on screen for the next person.
		self.view.custom.dialogOpen = False
		self.clearKeys()
